args.title: Bellwether Office: Retail Returns Logistics (article + companion)
args.body:
Combined summary of the Bellwether Office newsletter "Retail returns logistics" and its subscriber companion piece:

- Apparel return rates reached 24%.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling cost by a fifth.
- Resale within 10 days kept most of the margin.

Sources:
- Article: https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/returns
- Companion (subscriber): https://insights.bellwether.example/returns/companion?code=SUB-6746
